body: upgrade CALM to 1.3.2 for better macos experience

fix macos-14 arm64 codesign problem

still need to de-quarantine this application:

```bash
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Focalizzare.app
```

- Fix SDL2_mixer.dll error #3 
  thanks to @paulwalz
- ci: remove binary release for macOS-11

Use 'Liberation Sans' font on Linux.

This update doesn't effect macOS and Windows users.
Add shortcut <kbd>t</kbd> to toggle window always-on-top

Upgrade CALM to 1.0.1: Do not open audio automatically.

This upgrade has not effect to the users, it's solely for the [AppImage Catalog](https://appimage.github.io/).

https://github.com/AppImage/appimage.github.io/pull/3178
Lower glibc requirement on Linux, now requiring glibc 2.31
